title: showcase (zh-CN): the task detail page's "Awaiting review" callout stays English — its record:alert has no component id, so no translation can address it
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWJDYbbtH6dhJNoboN

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: 界面，zh-CN 会话打开任一 `status = in_review` 的任务详情页，实测两次）
业务理由: showcase 是新用户和评估者的第一眼。中文用户点开通知或列表进入一个评审中的任务，页面其余全是中文，唯独顶部黄色提示条是英文，像是没做完的翻译；清单项 i18n.notification-localized-and-clears 的 A1（不能是中英混排页）因此失败，发版清单一直红。#25505 已收尾的 showcase 中文化漏了这一块。
动手的读者: 拥有 `examples/app-showcase` 的车道：给 `src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` 的 `record:alert` 加组件 `id`，并在 `src/system/translations/index.ts` 的 zh-CN 包写 `pages.showcase_task_detail.components.ID.title/body`。
查重: `record:alert translation component id` 1 命中、`task-detail.page alert translation` 0、`showcase zh-CN untranslated page component` 36（均含已关）；最近邻 #25505（showcase 中文化，已关）、#26452、#27446（都是别的界面），都不是本现象。

QA-source: #28981 · i18n.notification-localized-and-clears · A1

## What happens
On a zh-CN session, the showcase task detail page (`showcase_task_detail`) renders every platform and object label in Chinese, but its review callout reads in English:

- title "Awaiting review"
- body "This task is in review — confirm the work before marking it done."

The callout shows for any task with `status = in_review`. The seed ships one ("Design system"), and the assignment notification of the checklist item lands on it.

Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02) on a stock showcase boot from a scratch copy, Console built from the same tree.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; sign in as admin with a zh-CN browser locale (`GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` answers `locale: zh-CN`).
2. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/record/ID` for the seeded task "Design system" (status 评审中).
3. **Expected:** the callout in Chinese, like the rest of the page.
4. **Actual:** "Awaiting review / This task is in review — confirm the work before marking it done." in English, above zh highlights (项目/负责人/优先级/截止日期/进度) and zh sections (概览/排期).

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts` (around L94–104) declares the `record:alert` with `visibleWhen` and `properties.title/body` but no `id`. Page copy is translated through `pages.NAME.components.COMPONENT_ID.KEY` (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, the `pages` block), so an id-less component cannot be addressed, and the zh-CN bundle carries no entry for it.
